findings.fact: The largest cloud companies said they would keep raising AI data-center spending next year, most of it on accelerator chips.
Executives named chip supply, power and networking as the limits on how fast new AI capacity comes online.
Utilities said data-center projects now make up a large share of requests for new grid connections.
Training clusters need high-speed networking between thousands of accelerators, a market several chip and equipment makers serve.
